speaker_role: independent counselor (founder of StudyAmerica, works with international students)
commercial_incentive: Sells counseling services and promotes a free masterclass and channel subscription.
key_insights: Avoid a recycled essay; a test is whether swapping in another nearby school's name would still fit.
Research through campus visits (virtual tours), student reviews on sites like Niche and College Confidential, and outreach to the university.
Ask schools to connect you with students from your country to get details competitors won't have.
Skip bland points about city, community and academics; go deeper into traditions, values and specifics.
Connect university values to your own with a bit of storytelling.
specific_numbers_or_facts: Speaker says applicants may write 30 to 50 supplemental essays in total.
Speaker claims 13 years of experience with students and personal financial aid experience at Columbia.
notable_or_distinctive: Suggests international applicants use virtual tours and country-specific student contacts, though mostly generic.
reliability_notes: Rambling delivery with a long poem analogy and sales pitch; captions have minor garbling and some claims are unsupported.
